preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains an integer n between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The second line contains a string s of length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in lines[1].strip())
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output string t is a permutation of the input string s (same characters with same counts).

postconditions.expression: palindromic_count(stdout.strip()) == max(palindromic_count(t) for t in permutations(s))
postconditions.description: The output string t has the maximum possible palindromic count among all permutations of s.
